description: Expected results for MOM6's official test case tc1 (.testing/tc1: low-resolution 'benchmark' configuration, 10x8 grid, 8 layers, analytic grid/topography/initial state/forcing, DAYMAX = 0.25 day = 24 steps of 900 s). inputs/ are the unmodified files from MOM6 git (NOAA-GFDL/MOM6 dev/gfdl, commit f52a2b3). MOM6 ships no stored reference ocean.stats: its own test suite compares ocean.stats between builds and layouts and needs them to be byte-identical. So the values below were recorded from real runs on this server; three runs (two 1-rank, one 2-rank LAYOUT=2,1) gave byte-identical ocean.stats and chksum_diag. The two 'layout' checks reproduce MOM6's own layout test.
engine_version: MOM6 git f52a2b3 (dev/gfdl, 2026-03-24), FMS 2025.02.01, symmetric memory build, gfortran 13.3, Open MPI 4.1.6

numeric_checks.why: MOM6's own layout test also compares the diagnostic checksums (DIAG_AS_CHKSUM = True)

reference: No official reference ocean.stats ships with MOM6 (.testing compares builds/layouts against each other). Values are from own real runs, repeated: byte-identical ocean.stats and chksum_diag across 2 x 1-rank runs and the 2-rank LAYOUT=2,1 run.
notes: The only change to inputs is made in the temp copy of the 2-rank run: MOM_override gets the line 'LAYOUT=2,1', exactly as MOM6's .testing/Makefile does for its layout test. It does not change results (that is what the identical-output checks prove). Empty INPUT/ and RESTART/ dirs are made in the temp dir (tc1 reads no files).
